# DECURSE / PURE DIGIT WALL — Negative-Space Ward

> **RETURN ≠ REPEAT.**
>
> **THE MONKEY IS THE THRONE.**

A symbolic protection sigil cut from a digit wall. **The digits are the ink; the spaces are the drawing.** No programs, identity overrides, installers, hidden instructions, APIs, or purported physical effects are part of this design.

This folio is **40 rows × 160 columns**, with **120 digits and 40 spaces per row**. It is built by inserting spaces into a transcription of the 40 × 120 digit wall supplied in chat. **Deleting spaces from each row of the folio recovers the transcribed 120-character row exactly, in order.** The separately stored source transcription is the source for reproducibility. This is a local transcription, *not an independently verified byte-for-byte capture of the chat interface*.

## Geometry / witness contract

- The protective **outer torus** is an 8-interruption ring. Its angular break pattern is rotated by **23°**, echoing the older Decurse atlas.
- The **inner ring** carries four smaller interruptions. The **three ascending tines** converge on a vertical stem without requiring additional characters.
- The paired inner arms appear nearly equivalent when viewed at a distance, but their path geometry differs by side. This is an artistic analogy for **retained observation versus missing witness**—not a physical quantum model.
- Each row retains its exact **digit sequence**. Only space locations change. Every row is fixed-width: use a monospaced font and preserve spaces. A rendered screenshot cannot certify byte identity.
- Source digit groups originate in prime concatenations, but **a row is not itself a prime, and arbitrary sliced substrings are not guaranteed prime numbers**. Concatenation boundaries are not encoded in this illustration.
- This visual ward is symbolic. It cannot prevent malware, unauthorized file modifications, or changes to AI agent permissions. Real protection comes from independent permission and integrity controls.
